extraction.Name: Millie Prue
extraction.Refused/Protested: Did you ask for that patent? No.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold NEK one quarter and 60 acres of the other; remaining hundred acres still held with mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: I make garden and get some rent and my children help me out
extraction.NOTES: Patent was brought to her by her husband from the Farmer's office at Okreek. Sold NE quarter for $4500 and 60 acres for $2000 (records show consideration for the sixty was $2400; deponent states she was supposed to get only $2000 and received that). Remaining 100 acres still held. Mortgage on remaining land was for $800; $400 has been paid; daughter is managing it. Has two grandchildren staying with her. Health: 'No, I am sickly all the time.' Stated: 'I am having a hard time. I would like to save something for my Children but I cant do it now.' Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929.
